title_en: Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Enhancing Judicial Capability and Improving Judicial Standards
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Enhancing Judicial Capability and Raising the Level of Judicial Work

Fa Fa [2005] No. 4

In order to implement the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, in accordance with the general requirements for strengthening the Party's governance capability, continuously enhance judicial capability, raise the level of judicial work, further strengthen and improve the work of the people's courts, and lawfully guarantee the smooth progress of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, the following opinions are hereby formulated.

I. The Importance and Urgency of Enhancing Judicial Capability and Raising the Level of Judicial Work

1. The people's courts are the judicial organs of the state, exercising adjudicative power in accordance with the Constitution and laws, and shouldering the important mission of implementing the strategy of governing the country according to law. The Fourth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China clearly put forward the guiding ideology, overall objectives, and main tasks for strengthening the Party's governance capability, further pointing the way for the work of the people's courts. The people's courts, under the leadership of the Party, are an important vehicle for implementing the strategy of governing the country according to law, an important force for the Party to manage state and social affairs through judicial means, and an important link for the Party to maintain the flesh-and-blood relationship with the masses through judicial channels. They must provide strong judicial guarantees for the realization of the overall objective of strengthening the Party's governance capability through fair, clean, civilized, and efficient judicial activities. Whether this can be achieved depends on whether we have judicial capability and a level of judicial work commensurate with strengthening the Party's governance capability.

2. For a long time, people's courts at all levels throughout the country, guided by Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents," have implemented the scientific development concept, firmly relied on the Party's leadership, consciously accepted the supervision of the people's congresses, strived to practice the work theme of "justice and efficiency," earnestly implemented the requirements of justice for the people, adhered to the work policy of "serving the overall situation by grasping adjudication, focusing on key points by grasping grassroots work, and centering on justice by grasping team building," fully played the role of adjudicative functions, and made unremitting efforts to safeguard national security and social stability, ensure the improvement of the socialist market economy system, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of the broad masses of the people.

3. Currently, the international and domestic situations are undergoing profound changes. Internationally, peace and development remain the themes of the times, but a small number of anti-China forces, relying on powerful political, economic, cultural, and Internet information technology means, continue to infiltrate us in all directions. Their attempts to subvert the leadership of the Communist Party and overthrow the system of people's democratic dictatorship have not changed, and the struggle against enemies remains complex. Domestically, China's reform and development are at a critical period. With the deepening of reform and opening up, the complexity of social interest relations, the diversity of values, the mobility of people and property, and the convenience of information dissemination have further developed. China is in a period of prominent contradictions among the people and a high incidence of criminal offenses. The tasks of the people's courts in safeguarding national security and social stability are heavy and arduous.

The objectives set forth by the Fourth Plenary Session of the Sixteenth Central Committee—developing the socialist market economy, developing socialist democratic politics, building an advanced socialist culture, and building a socialist harmonious society—have put forward new and higher requirements for the work of the people's courts. Facing the new situation and tasks, the people's courts must vigorously strengthen capability building, continuously enhance their ability and skill to follow the development laws of the socialist market economy, the construction laws of a socialist country under the rule of law, and the laws of judicial activities, centering on the work theme of "justice and efficiency," implementing the requirements of justice for the people, and using judicial means to safeguard the fundamental interests of the broadest masses of the people and maintain long-term stability of the country.

4. Over the years, the work of the people's courts has made significant progress, but there are still various problems restricting the development of the people's courts, mainly manifested as: the level of correctly applying the law is not yet high enough, the ability to resolve contradictions is not yet strong enough, the capability of fair adjudication is not yet sufficient, the judicial style is not yet rigorous enough, problems of unfair adjudication and low efficiency in some cases that have aroused strong public sentiment have not been completely solved, and the phenomenon of a small number of judges handling "relationship cases," "favor cases," and "money cases" remains persistent despite repeated prohibitions. People's courts at all levels must focus on solving existing problems in the practice of enhancing judicial capability and raising the level of judicial work, and ultimately through solving problems, promote the work of the people's courts to continuously open up new prospects. They must fully recognize the importance and urgency of enhancing judicial capability and raising the level of judicial work, continuously enhance the consciousness and initiative of practicing the work theme of "justice and efficiency," and doing a good job of the three major tasks of adjudication work, court reform, and team building, seize opportunities, meet challenges, seek truth and be pragmatic, and accelerate development.

II. The Guiding Ideology and Main Tasks for Enhancing Judicial Capability and Raising the Level of Judicial Work

5. The guiding ideology for the people's courts to enhance judicial capability and raise the level of judicial work is: Under the leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary, guided by Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, and the important thought of "Three Represents," in accordance with the requirements of the National Conference on Political and Legal Work to enhance five aspects of law enforcement and judicial capability, with "justice and efficiency" as the theme, with justice for the people as the starting point, with judicial system reform as the driving force, with grassroots construction of the people's courts as the foundation, and with building a high-quality team of judges as the guarantee, comprehensively enhance judicial capability and raise the level of judicial work. The key to adhering to the above guiding ideology is to always persist in relying on the Party's leadership over court work.

6. The main tasks for the people's courts to enhance judicial capability and raise the level of judicial work are: enhancing the capability to punish criminal offenses and safeguard national security and social stability; enhancing the capability to regulate economic relations and promote the healthy development of the socialist market economy; enhancing the capability to lawfully handle disputes and conflicts and ensure social harmony; enhancing the capability to support and promote law-based administration and advance the construction of socialist democratic politics; enhancing the capability to protect human rights in the judicial field and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the masses; and enhancing the capability to correctly apply the law, adjudicate fairly and efficiently, and ensure fairness and justice in the whole society. People's courts at all levels must closely focus on the above tasks, continuously study new situations, solve new problems, acquire new skills, and strive to do a good job of the three major tasks of adjudication work, team building, and court reform, comprehensively promoting the continuous development of all work of the people's courts.

III. Enhancing the Capability to Punish Criminal Offenses and Safeguard National Security and Social Stability

7. Safeguarding national security and social stability has always been a major political task for the people's courts. People's courts at all levels must further enhance their awareness of responsibility and sense of urgency, and earnestly do a good job of all work related to safeguarding national security and social stability.

8. We must resolutely and lawfully severely punish all types of crimes that endanger national security, such as splitting the state, undermining national unity, subverting state power, and overthrowing the socialist system. For various crimes endangering national security committed through the Internet, judicial response must be strengthened. High vigilance must be maintained against the new situation of the "Falun Gong" cult organization using legal means to confront us.

9. The objective situation that factors breeding and inducing crimes increase significantly during the period of economic and social transformation determines that the policy of severe punishment must be adhered to for a long time. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the targeted and effective nature of severe punishment, and pay attention to coordination and cooperation with other political and legal organs. Continue to implement the policy of law-based severe punishment unwaveringly, adhere to the regularity and long-term nature of severe punishment, continue to focus on cracking down on serious violent crimes, organized crimes, and multiple property rights infringement crimes such as theft, robbery, and snatching, increase the intensity of punishment for drug crimes, gambling crimes, and cyber crimes, purify the social environment, and ensure social stability.

10. Special attention must be paid to properly handling petitions involving litigation, firmly establishing the concept that "there are no small matters concerning the interests of the masses," patiently listen to the demands of visiting petitioners, fully respect and equally protect the litigation rights of the parties, earnestly safeguard the interests of the masses, and show socialist humanistic care to visiting petitioners. Strive to enhance the capability of handling petition visits involving litigation, fully utilize the judicial relief function of trial supervision work, adhere to the principle of handling matters according to law and policy, not only lawfully safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the masses, but also resolutely and severely deal with individual lawbreakers who intentionally disrupt social order.

11. Actively participate in the construction of the social security prevention and control system, strengthen legal publicity and education, strengthen judicial suggestion work, strengthen guidance for people's mediation work, enhance the trial work of juvenile delinquency, cooperate with relevant departments in carrying out community correction and assistance education work, and promote comprehensive management of social security.

IV. Enhancing the Capability to Regulate Economic Relations According to Law and Promote the Healthy Development of the Socialist Market Economy

12. Currently, China's economy is developing healthily, and the market economic order is continuously improving. However, economic crimes remain relatively prominent, and new types of crimes continue to appear, directly endangering national economic security. People's courts at all levels must focus on cracking down on serious economic crimes in areas related to national economic security such as finance, taxation, securities, and futures; serious economic crimes that affect the vital interests of the masses and affect social stability, such as illegal fund-raising; crimes that seriously disrupt the market economic order, such as production and sale of counterfeit and inferior goods, smuggling, and infringement of intellectual property rights; crimes of embezzling state-owned assets by taking advantage of opportunities of reform of state-owned enterprises; and especially lawfully severely punish criminal activities such as soliciting bribes, dereliction of duty, abuse of power, and engaging in malpractices for personal gain by state functionaries behind serious economic crimes.

13. Through the trial of a large number of civil and commercial cases, firmly implement the principle of equality of civil subjects, and create a fair and predictable judicial environment. For major cross-regional civil cases, legal measures such as designation of jurisdiction by a higher-level court may be adopted to eliminate interference from local protectionism. Strengthen trial guidance and supervision over bankruptcy cases of state-owned enterprises, strictly implement the plan for merger and bankruptcy of state-owned enterprises, strictly control the acceptance of bankruptcy cases, and curb the phenomenon of a "bankruptcy wave" or "bankruptcy movement" in individual localities, leading to a large amount of escape of bank claims. Continue to serve and obey the national macroeconomic regulation and control and monitoring of economic security, carefully try financial dispute cases, prevent acts of evading the law such as attempting to escape or eliminate debts through litigation, and maintain credit order. Sanction acts of breach of contract and dishonesty, uphold the commercial ethics of honesty and creditworthiness, and promote the establishment of a social credit system. Strengthen the trial of cases involving infringement of patent rights, trademark rights, copyrights, invention rights, trade secrets, etc., sanction acts of infringing intellectual property rights and abusing intellectual property rights, and lawfully ensure the standardization of the market economic order, the adjustment of economic structure, and the transformation of the economic growth mode.

V. Enhancing the Capability to Handle Conflicts and Disputes According to Law and Ensure Social Harmony

14. Lawfully handling cases of conflicts and disputes, achieving dispute resolution and case closure, is an important content and sign of the judicial capability of the people's courts, an important criterion for testing civil judicial activities, and an inevitable requirement for promoting social harmony and stability. When handling various conflicts and disputes, people's courts at all levels must pay attention to the unity of legal effect and social effect, correctly apply the law, ensure procedural legality and substantive justice, and as far as possible make the parties, whether they win or lose, convinced and satisfied, and strive to resolve various social conflicts.

15. Vigorously strengthen litigation mediation work, adhere to the requirement of "mediate when possible, adjudicate when appropriate, combine adjudication and mediation, and settle the case," and try to achieve the purpose of settling disputes through litigation mediation. While effectively solving the problems of unwillingness to mediate and inability to mediate caused by emphasizing adjudication and neglecting mediation, we must also prevent the problems of illegal mediation and forced mediation caused by one-sided pursuit of mediation rate, and resolutely prevent infringement of the legitimate rights and interests of the parties. At the same time, strengthen guidance for people's mediation work, closely integrate people's mediation and litigation mediation, fully mobilize various positive factors, explore and promote various alternative dispute resolution methods, and further improve the diversified handling mechanism for social conflicts and disputes.

16. Properly handle group litigation cases. When handling group cases, adhere to the principles of prudence and lawfulness. While strictly handling matters according to law and protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the parties, we must also implement the relevant policy requirements, patiently and meticulously do a good job of propaganda and education, and focus on and aim at resolving conflicts and disputes. Further implement and improve four mechanisms: first, a social stability early warning mechanism running through all links of court work, to timely discover and solve emerging and tendentious problems; second, a mechanism for investigation and mediation, which should regularly conduct investigation and mediation of key cases according to the principle of territorial jurisdiction; third, an emergency response mechanism, which should formulate detailed emergency plans to ensure timely, lawful, resolute, and effective handling of various incidents; fourth, a accountability mechanism, which shall seriously pursue the responsibility of leaders and directly responsible persons who fail to properly handle group incidents and cause serious consequences.

VI. Enhancing the Capability to Support and Promote Law-based Administration and Advance Socialist Democratic Politics

17. The administrative litigation system is of great significance for protecting the legitimate rights of administrative counterparts, coordinating the relationship between "officials and citizens," promoting social stability, promoting administrative organs to administer according to law, building a law-based and clean government, and advancing democratic political construction. People's courts at all levels must, through lawfully maintaining lawful administrative acts, correcting illegal administrative acts, coordinating the relationship between public power and citizens' rights, enhance mutual trust between the masses and the government, and reduce factors of social instability. While opposing the opposition of judicial supervision over administrative acts to maintaining social stability, and not accepting cases that should be accepted according to law, or not adjudicating and enforcing according to law, we must also overcome the viewpoint and tendency of "court omnipotence," and blindly accept or adjudicate beyond jurisdiction cases that do not fall within the scope of administrative adjudication under current legal provisions. In short, we must both be in place and not overstep, achieving supervision with strength and protection with method.

VII. Enhancing the Capability to Protect Human Rights in the Judicial Field and Safeguard the Legitimate Rights and Interests of the Masses

18. Judicial capability, fundamentally, is the capability to protect human rights through judicial means, to solve difficulties for the masses, and to serve the people wholeheartedly. People's courts at all levels must strengthen research on the inherent laws of criminal adjudication, while enhancing the capability to severely crack down on crimes and safeguard national security and social stability, also raise the level of protecting human rights according to law, and effectively ensure that innocent persons are not subject to criminal prosecution.

19. Conscientiously implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. While severely punishing crimes, for those with statutory leniency conditions, handle leniently according to law; for prisoners who meet the conditions for commutation of sentence or parole, grant commutation or parole according to law, and actively explore the publicity of commutation and parole and conditional hearing systems; for cases where the legal and policy boundaries are unclear, and it may or may not be sentenced, or may or may not be executed, handle leniently according to the specific circumstances. Further implement well the relevant notice requirements and various institutional measures to prevent extended detention and extended trial periods, consolidate existing achievements, and prevent the occurrence of new extended detention and extended trial periods. Effectively, through judicial activities, implement the principle of respecting and safeguarding human rights in all aspects of social life. Adhere to the people-oriented development concept, through lawfully safeguarding the exercise of citizens' political rights, through legal regulation of economic relations, and through promoting the achievements of spiritual civilization construction in judicial activities, promote the whole society to firmly establish the basic concept of respecting and safeguarding human rights, and strive to create a good social atmosphere of respecting, caring for, loving, and helping people.

VIII. Enhancing the Capability to Correctly Apply the Law, Adjudicate Fairly and Efficiently, and Ensure Fairness and Justice in the Whole Society

20. The soul and life of judicial work is judicial justice. The judicial goal that the people's courts always pursue and strive to achieve is also judicial justice. The fundamental criterion for measuring the strength of judicial capability and the level of judicial work is still judicial justice. The masses' expectation for judicial justice is the most ardent, and their criticism of judicial injustice is also the most intense. Although the number of cases with unfair adjudication and ineffective enforcement is small, their impact is very bad. This requires people's courts at all levels to improve their ability to learn and apply the law. They must not only have a fair heart but also take fair actions, and effectively seek fair results with fair ability. Therefore, judges' judgments must consider social stability and economic development, and should not pursue one legal value at the expense of other social values. On the basis of summing up the results of the educational activity of "upholding judicial justice to establish a good image," people's courts at all levels must establish a scientific judicial concept, adhere to the unity of substantive justice and procedural justice, adhere to the unity of legal truth and objective truth, resolutely resist and overcome various interferences such as human relations, favor, money, local and departmental protection, further improve and strengthen internal supervision, and effectively enhance the capability of fair and clean judicial work.

IX. Comprehensively Strengthening Court Team Building

21. The key to the people's courts' enhancement of judicial capability and raising the level of judicial work lies in building a court team that is politically steadfast, professionally proficient, work-style excellent, and judicially fair. With the goal of enhancing judicial capability and raising the level of judicial work, we must continuously strengthen the political quality, professional quality, and professional ethics quality of the court team, continue to promote the professionalization of judges, and provide strong organizational guarantees and talent support for realizing the theme of "justice and efficiency" and ensuring the development of adjudication work and other tasks of the people's courts.

22. Firmly establish the guiding position of the important thought of "Three Represents" in court team building, adhere to justice for the people, effectively solve the fundamental issue of for whom to enforce the law and for whom to serve, always put the protection of the people's interests first, adhere to the political essence of being loyal to the Party, loyal to the people, loyal to the facts, and loyal to the law, and maintain a high degree of consistency in thought and action with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary.

23. Seize the key link of leading cadres. Select and appoint to court leadership positions those who are politically steadfast, understand legal business, are in their prime, and meet the conditions of the Judges Law. In accordance with the requirements of political steadfastness, seeking truth and being pragmatic, pioneering and innovating, diligent and clean government, unity and cooperation, build the leadership teams of people's courts at all levels. Focus on enhancing the adjudication capability of leading cadres in terms of presiding over trials, judicial guidance, and judicial supervision; focus on enhancing management capability in terms of team management, trial management, and administrative management; focus on enhancing decision-making capability in terms of democratic decision-making, scientific decision-making, and law-based decision-making.

24. Higher-level people's courts shall, in accordance with the provisions on dual management of court leadership teams, strengthen the coordination management of leadership teams of lower-level people's courts, proactively communicate with local Party committees, and propose candidates and conduct evaluations in accordance with the conditions stipulated in the Judges Law. For vice presidents of courts appointed since 2002 who do not meet the conditions stipulated in the Judges Law, timely communicate with local Party committees to adjust the work. Strengthen the cultivation of reserve cadres for the people's courts. Adjustments and supplements to leadership team members shall strictly implement the provisions of the "Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres."

25. Based on improving the judicial capability and level of existing judges, focus on enhancing the ability to apply the law, the ability to preside over trials, and the ability to produce adjudicative documents, build a group of professional judges, strengthen professional awareness, establish professional ethics, and enhance professional skills; build a group of senior judges, develop superb skills, establish an authoritative image, and win public trust; build a group of outstanding judges, promote excellent character, defend the dignity of the law, and protect citizens' rights.

26. Efforts must be strengthened to establish management systems for cadres, and to establish and implement the system for court presidents and division chiefs to hear cases. Actively explore the organizational structure and operational mechanisms to guarantee that court presidents and division chiefs hear cases, set hard targets for the number of cases they directly participate in as members of collegiate benches each year, and incorporate these into the important content of post objective assessments. Leading officials at all levels, especially court presidents and division chiefs, must overcome all difficulties and interference and earnestly assume their trial responsibilities. In accordance with the principle of combining legal effect with social effect, a comprehensive scientific evaluation system for adjudication of all types of cases must be established in people's courts at all levels, and the review of trial quality and efficiency must be strengthened.

27. Continue to implement the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity, constantly enrich and improve the content of the responsibility system, and earnestly implement the systems for leading officials to report major matters, deliver work and integrity reports, undergo democratic evaluation, receive interviews and admonishment, be rotated and exchanged, and observe tenure avoidance. Strictly implement the regulations on intra-Party supervision, and strengthen supervision over leading officials of courts at all levels, especially the "top leader," so as to rely on clean and diligent leadership to produce a first-class team. Continuously intensify the efforts on integrity building, strengthen education on trial discipline for judges, educate judges to enhance their integrity awareness, establish and improve the system for Party conduct and clean governance, perfect trial supervision, leverage the advantage of higher-level courts in understanding the circumstances of case trials, lawfully correct instances of unfairness or dishonesty in the trial process of lower-level courts, improve the reporting and supervision system, strengthen supervision over judges' judicial conduct, uphold and improve the inspection tour system, attach importance to the use of inspection tour results, and promptly address issues of judicial dishonesty discovered during inspections.

28. Establish and improve the mechanism for guaranteeing court funding. Actively communicate with relevant departments, strive to implement the trial allowance system, actively promote local Party committees and governments to formulate and issue funding guarantee standards for grassroots courts as soon as possible, and strive for continued increase in central financial subsidies to grassroots courts.

29. Continue to deepen the reform of people's courts. In accordance with the overall plan and requirements of the central government for judicial system reform, the Supreme People's Court will promulgate and implement the "Second Five-Year Reform Outline for People's Courts." Starting from solving issues of judicial fairness and efficiency that concern the public, the focus will be on deepening the reform of criminal trial procedures, further perfecting the procedure for second instance criminal trials and the death penalty review procedure, improving the system for witnesses and expert witnesses to appear in court, and strengthening trial forces, so that every criminal case achieves procedural legality and substantive fairness and withstands the test of history. Reform the adjudication committee system to further promote the organic unity of trial and judgment, improving trial quality and work efficiency. Improve the people's assessor system, and, in conjunction with judicial administrative organs, select and train people's assessors, ensuring the people's lawful participation in trial activities and promoting judicial democracy. Reform and improve the adjudication supervision system for civil and administrative cases, respect and protect the parties' right to apply for retrial according to legal procedures, promptly accept cases of parties' appeals and applications for retrial, and solve the problem of "difficulty in filing lawsuits" for the people. Reform and improve the working mechanism for people's tribunals, standardize circuit trial work, allow people's tribunals to directly accept cases, and facilitate litigation for the people. In light of the psychological and physiological characteristics of minors and the special requirements of legal protection, reform and improve the juvenile justice system to strengthen protection of the lawful rights and interests of minors. Resolutely implement the "Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Issues Concerning the Management of Judicial Appraisals" to promote the improvement of the judicial appraisal management system. Reform the enforcement work system, actively participate in the construction of the social credit system, improve the information management system for enforcement cases, and encourage parties to voluntarily perform effective judgments.

X. Basic Requirements for Enhancing Judicial Capability and Improving Judicial Standards

30. Enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards is both a major task requiring constant attention and an urgent immediate task. In the process of strengthening judicial capacity building, we must always adhere to the ideological line of emancipating the mind, seeking truth from facts, keeping pace with the times, and being pragmatic. We must proceed from reality in everything, and proceed from the laws of judicial work in everything.

31. Enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards must be tailored to time and place, and not be uniform. While implementing the overall task of enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards, we must base ourselves on the overall work situation and environment of the region, base ourselves on the actual situation of trial, enforcement, and other work and the team, proceed from the current status and foundation of judicial capability and judicial standards of each region and unit, accurately grasp the main aspects and weak links of judicial capability, and scientifically determine work priorities and means of achievement. We must avoid both deviating from the overall task of enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards by doing something else entirely, and also avoid dogmatic recitation of texts and falling into doctrinairism. While adhering to the established policies for strengthening judicial capacity building, we must keep pace with the times, and timely adjust work priorities based on the progress of enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards and changes in the judicial environment. We must avoid both capricious changes to ensure the continuity and stability of judicial capacity building, and also avoid clinging to outdated practices and falling into empiricism.

32. Enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards must be closely integrated with the "one theme and three major tasks." Persist in maintaining the scientific work pattern of the people's courts of "one theme and three major tasks" unchanged, ensure that the various requirements for strengthening judicial capacity building are implemented, and test the results of strengthening judicial capacity building through the actual effects of promoting progress in all work and improving the level of judicial fairness and efficiency.

33. Enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards must strengthen organizational leadership. People's courts at all levels must promptly formulate implementation plans for strengthening judicial capacity building, determining the work priorities, methods, stages and steps, and specific objectives for each region and unit to enhance judicial capability and improve judicial standards for a certain period. The Supreme People's Court will, according to actual circumstances, dispatch inspection teams to certain regions and certain courts for supervision and inspection at appropriate times. Higher-level courts, especially the High Courts, must also conduct regular supervision and inspections, promptly identifying and solving prominent problems currently existing within their jurisdictions. Each High Court shall promptly report to the Supreme People's Court on the situation of strengthening judicial capacity building within its jurisdiction, especially typical experiences and prominent problems. Each year, commend and publicize a certain number of advanced models from people's courts at all levels who have enhanced judicial capability and improved judicial standards, strengthen the publicity of advanced experiences and practices, and create a favorable atmosphere for enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards.

34. Enhancing judicial capability and improving judicial standards must be combined with education on maintaining the vanguard nature of the Party. In accordance with the central government's deployment of the education campaign on maintaining the vanguard nature of Communist Party members, and combined with the actual situation of the courts, we must implement the four links of study, presentation, reform, and establishment, promoting all judges and other staff to constantly bear in mind professional ethics, ensure judicial integrity, and promote judicial culture. Organize party members to earnestly study Comrade Mao Zedong's "Serve the People" and "The Three Major Work Styles of the Communist Party of China," Comrade Deng Xiaoping's "Building Socialism with Chinese Characteristics" and "We Can Only Unite by Relying on Ideals and Discipline," Comrade Jiang Zemin's "On Strengthening and Improving the Construction of the Ruling Party," and Comrade Hu Jintao's "Vigorously Promote the Spirit of Seeking Truth and Pragmatism Throughout the Party, Foster a Strong Atmosphere of Seeking Truth and Pragmatism" and "Establish and Implement the Scientific Outlook on Development" and other important works. Organize party members to seriously analyze and evaluate their own problems in thought, work, and work style, carry out mutual evaluations among party members, and conduct criticism and self-criticism. Carefully formulate corrective measures for various problems discovered, clarify the focus of rectification, assign responsibility for rectification, and earnestly carry out rectification. Through the vanguard nature education campaign, effectively resolve prominent issues that the masses strongly reflect and that can be resolved through effort, thereby promoting the enhancement of judicial capability and the improvement of judicial standards.

April 1, 2005
